deviations.what: sap.m.Avatar (control @since 1.73, incl. its src/class/press members) is used 1:1 in snappedContent and the DynamicPageHeader; needs UI5 >= 1.73. DynamicPage is the in-scope headline control (@1.42); Avatar is a secondary control kept 1:1 per the post-1.71 member policy.

The controller's breakpointChange handling is dropped: onBreakpointChange read currentRange/currentWidth and imperatively setDisplaySize on the header/snapped Avatars (M/L/XL) plus toasted 'Media Range: ...'. The responsive Avatar resizing and the toast are omitted; the Avatars render at their default displaySize. The DynamicPage has no breakpointChange view attribute (attached imperatively), so no structural-diff impact. Review 2026-07-27: the original rationale (CAPABILITIES 'Event args derived from runtime layout/overflow measurement' not expressible) does NOT hold here - breakpointChange is a declarable metadata event of sap.f.DynamicPage (since UI5 1.147, would be a POST_171 deviation) and its currentRange/currentWidth are ordinary event parameters transportable via ${$parameters>/...}; a faithful reproduction (event round-trip, displaySize two-way bound and recomputed in ABAP, client-composed 'Media Range: {0} ({1}px)' toast) appears expressible. Needs rework - left status generated.

showFooter is two-way bound ({/SHOW_FOOTER}, default true) and the Toggle Footer button flips it on a round-trip (view_model_update) - the faithful abap2UI5 form of the controller's setShowFooter(!getShowFooter()); the scalar literal showFooter="true" -> binding is not a structural diff. The Home/Examples/Avatar presses raise client-composed MessageToasts via _event_client control_global MESSAGE_TOAST (roundtrip-free, apps 005/060). Both the footer round-trip and the toast wiring are unverified in a running system.

The two Avatar src values point at the sdk.openui5.org host (https://sdk.openui5.org/test-resources/sap/uxap/images/imageID_275314.png) per the offline asset-URL rule; the original uses the relative ./test-resources path. Literal src values are not compared by structural-diff.
